column1: # The book's term register: every concept and every named skill or tool a reader
# must be introduced to, and the chapter that introduces it. Checked against the
# DRAFTS (not only the outline) by tools/check-intro-order.py.
# id           unique; concept ids are the node names in deps.txt
# introduced   outline chapter id (I.1, II.3, III.2 ...). "Introduced" means the
#              reader first gets enough to follow — a gloss counts; the full
# match        Python regex for a USE of the term in prose, case-insensitive.
#              "auto" = the name in backticks (skills and tools).
#              "-" = no usage check (the word is too ordinary to find); the
#              marker and dependency checks still apply.
